title: Characteristic Independence of Betti Numbers of Monomial Ideals in Five Variables
summary: Alesandroni proved that Betti numbers of monomial ideals in at most four variables are independent of the characteristic of the base field, while characteristic-dependent Betti numbers occur in six variables. We prove that the five-variable case is characteristic-independent. More precisely, if $S=k[x_1,\ldots,x_5]$ and $M\subseteq S$ is a monomial ideal, then the multigraded, graded, and total Betti numbers of $S/M$ are independent of $\operatorname{char}(k)$.
